details.biography:
With a love of creative prosthetics, Robb Crafer has worked on some of the most recognisable Hollywood films in recent years. An expert in crafting and applying facial and body prosthetics, he also has several years of teaching experience.

Since beginning in prosthetics, Robb has gone on to work on blockbusters like Maleficent, Guardians of the Galaxy, Jupiter Ascending, and Avengers: Age of Ultron. He also has fantastic television experience, working as a prosthetic makeup artist on popular TV series including Glue and Bad Education.

A qualified teacher in mainstream education, Robb re-trained as a prosthetics makeup artist, making the transition into teaching this medium an easy one. Robb most recently taught at Greasepaint Makeup School before joining the team at The Iver Academy. He now brings his creativity and enthusiasm to our prosthetics courses, training students on the best-practice techniques and industry standards required for film and TV media work.
details.name: Robb Crafer
